title: 天皇賞（秋）の後に・烈火轟轟

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki takes first place, and even her rivals compliment her performance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They tell her they vastly prefer when she runs with her heart on her sleeve. Not only that, they also feel they know Yaeno Muteki better now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tears well up in Yaeno's eyes at these words. Running with her emotions was such a breath of fresh air. She wants to continue racing this way with everyone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having gained the recognition she's been seeking, it's clear from the joyous smile on her face that she's gained confidence.
